>
[Icicle](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2868)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=555" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 242

**Price** 10,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Longspear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=361)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+2 greater striking [greater frost](/Equipment.aspx?ID=296) [longspear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=6)_ appears to be a single continuous icicle stretching over 6 feet long. The icicle automatically extinguishes non-magical fires in a 20-foot emanation. While wielding it, you gain fire resistance 5. 

**Activate—Quench Flames** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You swing the _icicle_ into the area of an ongoing magical fire, and the spear attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) the fire with a counteract modifier of +27. If it fails, it can't attempt to counteract the same fire again.  

**Activate—Ice Spike** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _icicle_ grows rapidly, piercing creatures in a 30-foot line. Each creature in the area takes 11d6 cold damage with a DC 35 Reflex save. A creature that fails its save also takes 3d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29)(double on a critical failure). 

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
